doc_title_en: Notice Regarding Revision of Year-End Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase)
doc_title_jp: 期末配当予想の修正（増配）に関するお知らせ

key_facts.reason_jp: 第2四半期までの業績等を勘案し、株主への利益還元を重視

summary_en: Year-end dividend for fiscal year ending March 2027 raised by 1 yen to 26 yen per share, bringing full-year dividend to 51 yen per share from previously guided 50 yen, reflecting performance through the second quarter.
summary_jp: 2027年3月期の期末配当を前回予想の25円から26円に1円増配。通期配当は51円となる。第2四半期までの業績を踏まえた修正。
